recipes.title: Survival Frittata
steps: 1. Preheat boiler (if available) or prepare skillet lid.
2. Whisk eggs and liquid distinctively.
3. Sauté mix-ins in an oven-safe skillet.
4. Pour egg mixture over mix-ins. Do not stir.
5. Cook on low heat until edges are set.
6. Transfer to oven/broiler to finish top, or cover with lid to steam.

recipes.title: Pantry Stir Fry
ingredients: Sauce: Soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, ginger
steps: 1. Mix sauce ingredients in a small cup.
2. Heat oil in wok or skillet until smoking.
3. Sear protein quickly. Remove.
4. Stir fry vegetables until crisp-tender.
5. Return protein and add carbs.
6. Pour sauce over everything and toss to coat.

recipes.title: Depression Era Pasta
steps: 1. Boil pasta in salted water. Reserve 1 cup water before draining.
2. In the same pot, sauté aromatics or mix-ins.
3. Add tomato sauce and heat through.
4. Toss pasta with sauce, adding reserved water to thin if needed.

recipes.title: Stone Soup
steps: 1. Brown any meat or bones in the bottom of the pot.
2. Add liquid and bring to a simmer.
3. Add sturdy vegetables (potatoes/carrots). Simmer 20m.
4. Add soft vegetables and grains. Simmer 15m.
5. Season aggressively.

recipes.title: Savory Oatmeal Bowl
steps: 1. Boil oats in salted liquid.
2. While hot, stir in an egg (it will cook in the oats) or top with fried egg.
3. Add soy sauce, sesame oil, or whatever savory condiments you have.

recipes.title: Red Beans & Rice
steps: 1. Sauté onion and pepper (and meat if using).
2. Add beans and cover with water by 2 inches.
3. Simmer until beans are creamy (1.5 - 2 hours).
4. Mash some beans against the side of the pot to thicken.
5. Serve over white rice.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
steps: 1. Boil noodles al dente.
2. Mix drained tuna, soup, peas, and noodles.
3. Pout into baking dish.
4. Top with crushed crackers.
5. Bake at 350F for 20-25 mins until bubbly.

recipes.title: Basic Sourdough Loaf
steps: 1. Dissolve starter in water.
2. Mix in flour and salt until shaggy dough forms. Rest 30m.
3. Perform 4 sets of 'Stretch and Folds' every 30 mins.
4. Bulk Rise: Let sit at room temp for 4-8 hours until doubled.
5. Shape into a round. Place in banneton/bowl. Fridge overnight.
6. Bake in Dutch Oven: 450F (20m lid on, 25m lid off).

recipes.title: Survival Hardtack
steps: 1. Mix ingredients into a very stiff dough.
2. Roll out to 1/2 inch thickness.
3. Cut into 3x3 squares.
4. Poke holes using a nail/chopstick (prevents puffing).
5. Bake 375F for 30 mins. Flip. Bake 30 mins more.
6. Cool completely. Should be hard as a brick.

recipes.title: Campfire Bannock
steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Add oil and enough water to make a pliable dough.
3. Form into a patty (1 inch thick).
4. Fry in a greased skillet over coals, flip when golden.
5. PRO TIP: Can also wrap around a stick and roast.

recipes.title: Simple Yeast Bread
steps: 1. Bloom yeast in warm water with sugar for 5 mins.
2. Mix flour and salt. Add yeast water.
3. Knead 10 mins until smooth.
4. Rise 1 hour (doubled).
5. Punch down, shape loaf. Rise 30 mins.
6. Bake 400F for 30-35 mins.

recipes.title: Flour Tortillas
steps: 1. Cut fat into dry ingredients.
2. Add water, knead until smooth.
3. Divide into 8 balls. Rest 20 mins (Critical step!).
4. Roll paper thin.
5. Cook on HOT dry skillet, 30s per side (until bubbly).

recipes.title: Muscle Meat Jerky
steps: 1. Slice meat 1/4 inch thick. Remove ALL fat.
2. Marinate 12-24 hours.
3. Pat dry.
4. Dehydrate at 160F (or oven lowest setting door cracked) for 4-6 hours.
5. Done when it bends and cracks (white fibers visible) but doesn't snap.

recipes.title: Basic Sauerkraut
steps: 1. Shred cabbage finely.
2. Massage salt into cabbage until it releases liquid (brine).
3. Pack tightly into jar. Ensure cabbage is submerged in liquid.
4. Weigh down (bag of water or glass weight).
5. Ferment 3-4 weeks at room temp. Burp jar daily if needed.

recipes.title: Canned Tomatoes (Water Bath)
steps: 1. Score tomatoes, boil 1m, peel skins.
2. Pack into sterilized jars.
3. Add 1 tbsp lemon juice per pint (Critical for acid safety).
4. Leave 1/2 inch headspace.
5. Process in boiling water bath: 40 mins for pints, 45 for quarts.

recipes.title: Rabbit Stew
steps: 1. Dust rabbit pieces in flour, salt, pepper.
2. Brown in hot fat (bacon grease is best). Remove.
3. Sauté veggies.
4. Return rabbit, cover with cider/broth.
5. Simmer gently 1.5 - 2 hours until falling off bone.

recipes.title: Pan Fried Trout
steps: 1. Score skin of fish lightly.
2. Dredge in seasoned cornmeal.
3. Fry in hot butter/oil over medium heat.
4. 4-5 mins per side. Flesh flakes easily when done.

recipes.title: Venison Chili
steps: 1. Brown venison with onions.
2. Add spices and toast for 1 min.
3. Add remaining ingredients.
4. Simmer low and slow (venison is lean, don't boil hard).

recipes.title: Corned Beef Hash
steps: 1. Boil potato dice for 5 mins to soften. Drain.
2. Fry onion and potatoes in oil until starting to crisp.
3. Crumble in corned beef.
4. Press down with spatula to form crust. Flip and crisp other side.

recipes.title: Pantry Shakshuka
steps: 1. Sauté onion/garlic.
2. Add tomatoes and spices. Simmer 5 mins.
3. Make 4 divots in the sauce.
4. Crack eggs into divots.
5. Cover pan. Simmer 5-7 mins until whites set.

recipes.title: Lentil Tacos
steps: 1. Simmer lentils in water until soft (20m). Drain excess liquid.
2. Mash partially with fork.
3. Stir in taco seasoning.
4. Serve in tortillas.

recipes.title: Stovetop Rice Pudding
steps: 1. Combine rice, milk, sugar in pot.
2. Simmer medium-low, stirring often (scorches easily).
3. Cook until thickened (15-20m).
4. Add cinnamon/raisins off heat.

recipes.title: One Pot Chili Mac
steps: 1. Combine macaroni, chili, tomatoes, and 1 tomato-can of water in pot.
2. Bring to boil.
3. Simmer covered, stirring occasionally, until pasta is tender (10-12m).
4. Top with cheese if you have it.

recipes.title: Spam Musubi Bowl
steps: 1. Cut Spam into slices.
2. Fry until crispy.
3. Add splash of soy sauce and sprinkle of sugar to pan to glaze.
4. Serve glazed Spam over rice with crumbled nori.

recipes.title: Canned Fruit Cobbler
ingredients: 1 box Yellow Cake Mix (or flour/sugar/butter mix)
steps: 1. Pour fruit into baking dish.
2. Sprinkle dry cake mix over fruit.
3. Slice butter thinly and arrange over top.
4. Bake 375F for 35-40 mins until golden and bubbly.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
steps: 1. Drain salmon.
2. Mix all ingredients. If too wet, add more crumbs.
3. Form into patties.
4. Pan fry in oil until golden brown on both sides.

recipes.title: Cowboy Caviar
steps: 1. Rinse all canned beans well.
2. Mix in bowl.
3. Toss with Italian dressing or vinegar/oil mix.
4. Serve as dip with chips or side salad.

recipes.title: Traditional Pemmican
steps: 1. Pound dried meat into a fluff/powder.
2. Melt tallow.
3. Mix meat powder and tallow 1:1 by weight.
4. Press into molds/blocks.
5. Will last years without refrigeration.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Pickles
steps: 1. Slice veggies into jars.
2. Boil vinegar, water, and salt to dissolve.
3. Pour hot brine over veggies.
4. Cool. Fridge. Ready in 24 hours.

recipes.title: Basic Lye Soap (Hot Process)
steps: 1. OUTDOORS: Add Lye to Water. (NEVER WATER TO LYE). Mix.
2. Melt fat. Coll lye and fat to ~100F.
3. Add Lye Water to Fat.
4. Stick lend to 'Trace' (pudding consistency).
5. Pour into mold. Insulate. Cut after 24 hours. Cure 4 weeks.
